item.title: Nvidia Will Spend $26 Billion to Build Open-Weight AI Models, Filings Show
item.description: The move could position the AI infrastructure powerhouse to quickly compete with OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek.

item.title: Meta Is Developing 4 New Chips to Power Its AI and Recommendation Systems
item.description: The MTIA processors are the tech giant’s latest attempt to build its own AI hardware, even as it continues spending billions on gear from industry leaders like Nvidia.

item.title: This Digital Picture Frame Wants to Bring People Closer to a Holographic Future
item.description: Brooklyn-based Looking Glass has been dabbling in 3D screens for nearly a decade. It's finally launching Musubi, an AI-powered holographic frame to bring your photos and videos to life.

item.title: Nick Clegg Doesn’t Want to Talk About Superintelligence
item.description: After leaving Meta last year, the former deputy prime minister of the UK is charting a new path in the AI industry that has nothing to do with AGI.

item.title: Teens Are Using AI-Fueled ‘Slander Pages’ to Mock Their Teachers
item.description: Viral student-run TikTok and Instagram accounts are using AI to make memes of school faculty comparing them to figures like Jeffrey Epstein and Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Inside OpenAI’s Race to Catch Up to Claude Code
item.description: Why is the biggest name in AI late to the AI coding revolution?

item.title: Trump Administration Won’t Rule Out Further Action Against Anthropic
item.description: The White House is preparing an executive order targeting the AI startup, even as its earlier actions against the company face a major test in court.

item.title: Fake AI Content About the Iran War Is All Over X
item.description: X’s Grok is failing to accurately verify video footage from the Iran conflict and is sharing its own AI-generated images about the war.

item.title: I Used Google’s New Gemini-Powered ‘Help Me Create’ Tool in Docs. It’s Great at Corporate-Speak
item.description: Google has injected Docs, Drive, Sheets, and Slides with its Gemini assistant, adding new features that can pull information from your emails and the web to help you draft content. I gave it a whirl.

item.title: Yann LeCun Raises $1 Billion to Build AI That Understands the Physical World
item.description: Meta’s former chief AI scientist has long argued that human-level AI will come from mastering the physical world, not language. His new startup, AMI, aims to prove it.
